All acceptance criteria passed: Afdruk button renders dropdown via portal above modal, KT-V520 option is correctly disabled with hint 'Geen KT-V520 online' when no printer online, backdrop click closes menu, 'Afdrukken' option fires window.print (local), and WhatsApp button remains functional.
scenarios_not_executed: Live WebSocket-connected KT-V520 printer scenario (optional per request). Only tested the no-printer-online path. Backend remote-print flow was previously verified in iter80-86.
critical_code_review_comments: PrintChoiceMenu.jsx L57: sendKtp calls onStatus / first.name without guarding against first being undefined between render and click. UI prevents click via disabled, but if printer disappears between render and click there is still a theoretical TypeError. Low-risk because disabled prevents the handler being called when !first.

KioskLayout.jsx L1189-1195: setTimeout clears status after 2500ms only when kind==='ok'. For local print this is fine, but if subsequent interactions override state the dangling timer could clear a newer status prematurely. Minor.
No visible unit test coverage for PrintChoiceMenu. Consider jest/vitest test for the 'first printer wins' behaviour per the user's choice.
